scope: Server ownership service, route, consent form and real local handoff/deletion verification. Not full P2 acceptance.
implemented: POST /api/servers/{serverId}/transfer-ownership binds account and server identity, rejects unknown/oversized/multiple JSON bodies, requires password, separate consent and exact TRANSFER text. Actual ownership/eligible recipient checks remain transactional; no generic administrator bypass.
Fresh password/MFA verification uses the existing durable attempt budget and single-use recovery proofs. Password, factor and session changes after proof cannot commit the transfer.

Committed transfer clears local permission caches and sends server_update. Member refresh is server-scoped and forced; an older in-flight member list cannot overwrite refreshed roles or resurrect a left server.

Account deletion lists offer actual handoff forms; server general settings also expose the form to their owner. Forms preserve credentials on cancellation/failure, require fresh ownership after uncertain responses and ignore late account-generation responses.
Audit snapshots are written inside the ownership transaction; Turkish/English templates and API documentation were added.
automated: Full Go test ./... -json passed after service/handler/route additions, including proof races, audit failure rollback, runtime invalidation order and route gate/golden checks.
Focused six client files: 46 tests passed, covering transfer, deletion, credentials, member races, server WS refresh and microphone test lifecycle.
Full client suite: 178 files / 1853 tests passed after replacing an intermediate audio-construction wait with the actual meter-result wait in a previously timing-dependent microphone test.
TypeScript build and web production build passed (1589 transformed modules). Existing bundle-size/dynamic-import/config-loader warnings remain.
Targeted ESLint checks passed for new transfer files and modified settings/member/WS files.

real_local_acceptance.rounds: 51-72; failed observation/setup assertions were inspected and resumed without replaying committed mutations
checks: Transferred ownership using the visible recipient/password/TRANSFER/checkbox form and final danger dialog.

Deletion requirements refreshed to no owned resources after successful handoff.
Deleted only the disposable former-owner account using the visible DELETE/checkbox/final dialog. UI returned to login.

Independent recipient sign-in still read the transferred server and exact plaintext fixture message 3d065c32eb2f9253 under Deleted User; old personal audit names were gone and only recipient membership remained.
Explicit restore login for the deleted fixture was rejected. Returned browser to p1_acceptance afterward; its original server was untouched.
